summary: Comprehensive testing of Operoo Staff and Guest Management Platform - Phase 1 (Login/Auth + Dashboard + Navigation). All 15 backend API tests passed. All frontend UI tests passed including login flow, registration, dashboard, sidebar navigation, language switcher, logout, protected routes, and guest page.

minor.issue: In load-balanced environments (Kubernetes), brute force protection may not trigger lockout as requests come from different internal IPs. The mechanism exists and records attempts, but lockout may not be effective across load balancers.

action_items: Consider using X-Forwarded-For header for brute force protection in load-balanced environments to get real client IP
critical_code_review_comments: Code quality is good - proper separation of concerns, data-testid attributes on all interactive elements
Auth implementation follows best practices with httpOnly cookies, JWT tokens, and proper password hashing with bcrypt
i18n implementation is clean with proper translation files for EN/IT
seed_data_creation: Admin user seeded on startup via server.py startup event
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 testing complete. All auth flows working (login, register, logout, protected routes). Dashboard with stats, quick actions, recent activity working. Sidebar with 6 nav items working. Language switcher EN/IT working. Guest page at /guest/:token accessible without auth. Google OAuth callback endpoint exists but requires real Google login to test end-to-end.

backend_api: POST /api/auth/login - JWT login with admin credentials
frontend_ui: Login page renders with Google button, email/password form, Operoo branding
Register page renders with all fields (name, email, password)
JWT email/password login with admin account
Dashboard shows stats cards, quick actions, recent activity
Sidebar has all 6 items (Dashboard, Staff, Appointments, Clients, Marketing, Shop)
Language switcher (EN/IT) changes text on dashboard
Logout clears session and redirects to login
Protected routes redirect to /login when not authenticated
Public routes redirect to /dashboard when authenticated
Guest page at /guest/:token renders without authentication
Registration creates new user and logs in
